title: The degree-diameter problem for circulant graphs

template.title: Circulant graph of degree {d} and diameter {k}
template.statement: Find a circulant graph C_n(S) (vertices 0..n-1, x joined to x + s and x - s modulo n for every jump s in S) of degree at most {d} and diameter at most {k}, with as many vertices n as possible.
template.submission: Text file: n on the first line, then the jumps (integers separated by spaces); see checkers/circulant_check.py.

best_text: The largest known circulant graph in the Combinatorics Wiki's table has {best} vertices ({holder}); a graph with more vertices improves it.
open_rule: every entry of the table (degree 3 to 20, diameter 2 to 16) not in bold (bold entries are known to be optimal)
keeper: Combinatorics Wiki (E. Loz, H. Pérez-Rosés, G. Pineda-Villavicencio and contributors), The Degree Diameter Problem for Circulant Graphs
revision: pages read 15 Nov 2026 12:13 UTC (SHA-256 in page_sha256)
score: the number of vertices (larger is better)
holder_unknown: not named in the table's colour key
holder_sources: the colour of the entry in the table and the page's colour key
